warnings.title: Nylon Material Settings
warnings.message:
Printing with Nylon requires specific settings to prevent stringing:

Would you like to apply the recommended settings?
• Reduce crossing wall: Enabled
• Max travel detour distance: 0mm

Yes - Apply settings and slice
No  - Slice without changes

warnings.title: Nozzle Type Check — Brass Required
warnings.message:
Your filament has an HRC hardness value of {required_nozzle_HRC}.

For filaments with HRC ≤ 2, a BRASS nozzle is required.

Please verify you have the correct nozzle type installed before printing.

warnings.title: Nozzle Type Check — Stainless Steel Required
warnings.message:
Your filament has an HRC hardness value of {required_nozzle_HRC}.

For filaments with 2 < HRC ≤ 20, a STAINLESS STEEL nozzle is required.

Please verify you have the correct nozzle type installed before printing.

warnings.title: Nozzle Type Check — Hardened Steel Required
warnings.message:
Your filament has an HRC hardness value of {required_nozzle_HRC}.

warnings.title: Nozzle Type Check — CHT Nozzle Required
warnings.message:

warnings.message:
Ironing is enabled for this print.
